<thought>Mass spectrometry shows a monoisotopic ion at m/z 114.06808, which corresponds to the formula C₆H₁₀O₂ (DBE = 2). A common structure with this formula is a six‑membered lactone (one carbonyl and one ring). The SMILES for ε‑caprolactone, a C₆H₁₀O₂ lactone, is “O=C1CCCCCO1”, which has been validated as a correct SMILES string. This is the most plausible structure for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1CCCCCO1</final_answer>
